programme.desc: Žogarija je projekt, ki uteleša eno naših najpomembnejših prepričanj – da šport lahko izboljša kakovost življenja mladih. Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.title: Equitation : Championnats du monde

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Suivez des courses du Championnat du monde de motocross. Chaque année, les meilleurs pilotes du monde s'affrontent pour le titre décerné par la Fédération internationale de motocyclisme. De mars à octobre, ils concourent sur 20 circuits en Europe, en Asie, en Amérique du Sud et du Nord. Le championnat du monde se déroule dans les catégories de moteurs MXGP, MX2 et MX3.

MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. programme.title: 30 for 30: Once Upon a Time in Queens, Part 1
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: 30 for 30: Once Upon a Time in Queens, Part 2
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Formule E : ePrix de Sao Paulo
programme.desc: Le ePrix de São Paulo est une course du championnat du monde de Formule E FIA. Disputée sur le São Paulo Street Circuit à São Paulo, long de 2,933 km, la course est organisée pour la première fois le 25 mars 2023, après plusieurs tentatives infructueuses.

programme.title: Mexico City | Les meilleurs moments
programme.desc: Diffusion du ePrix de Mexico, une course du championnat du monde de Formule E FIA. Disputée depuis 2016, cette épreuve du championnat FIA de monoplaces électrique se déroule au circuit de Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, long de 2,606 km. Les 36 tours de piste nous offrent un vainqueur qui, en plus de remporter ce trophée, récupère le maximum de points en vue de la lutte pour le titre final.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Suivez la Coupe du monde de cross-country, une série de courses de VTT multi-épreuves gérée par l'Union Cycliste Internationale. La première série de Coupes du monde, composée d'épreuves de cross-country, a eu lieu en 1989. La Coupe du monde de descente a été inaugurée deux ans plus tard, et celle de slalom double en 1998. Les coureurs gagnent des points en fonction de leur classement dans chaque épreuve.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour d'Espagne
programme.desc: La première étape en ligne de la Vuelta 2026 est également la plus longue de cette édition. Très technique dans sa première partie, elle traversera des villes comme Nice et Grasse. Les magnifiques paysages de la Provence accueilleront les coureurs lors d'une journée qui devrait favoriser les meilleurs sprinteurs du peloton.

programme.title: Les Rois de la Pédale | L'avant-course
programme.desc: Retrouvez Louis-Pierre Frileux avec ses consultants qui débriefent et commentent toute l'actualité du cyclisme en plateau. Ils reviennent sur les dernières infos des équipes et les derniers résultats des courses. En bonus certains de ces champions de la pédale seront interviewés.

programme.title: La Vuelta | 3e étape
programme.desc: Une 3e étape qui commence sur le plat, pour monter progressivement vers les Pyrénées-Orientales. Le col de Mont-Louis (1560 m) sera la première difficulté marquante de cette édition, précédant Font-Romeu, première arrivée en altitude de la course (1930 m). Il permettra de définir un premier groupe de vingt à trente coureurs solides qui devraient se disputer les places d'honneur de cette Vuelta 2026.

programme.title: Wuhan Open
programme.desc: Le joueur chinois de 37 ans Xiao Guodong, actuel n°11 mondial, est le double tenant du titre de l'Open de Wuhan. L'an dernier, il avait remporté le tournoi pour la deuxième année consécutive en battant l'Anglais Gary Wilson (10-9), au terme d'une finale à suspense. L'année précédente, Xiao avait décroché son premier titre classé en s'imposant (10-7) face à Si Jiahui, lors d'une finale 100 % chinoise.

programme.title: Tennis : US Open
programme.desc: Suivez les principaux matchs de ce prestigieux tournoi. programme.title: Berlin | Les meilleurs moments
programme.desc: Après Madrid, direction Berlin pour les 7e et 8e courses de la saison, sur le circuit de Jarama. L'Allemand Pascal Wehrlein (Porsche) est en tête du classement des pilotes et il tentera de conforter sa place, devant son public. Mais le Portugais António Félix da Costa (Jaguar) est l'homme en forme du moment, puisqu'il a remporté les deux dernières courses, à Jeddah et Madrid.

programme.title: 6 Heures de São Paulo | Les meilleurs moments
programme.desc: Un mois après les 24 Heures du Mans, remportées par Toyota, avec Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi et Nyck de Vries, qui va s'imposer sur le légendaire circuit d'Interlagos, au Brésil ? programme.title: Equitation : Championnats du monde
programme.desc: En saut d'obstacles, l'équipe de France est composée de Julien Epaillard, Antoine Ermann, Nina Mallevaey, Olivier Perreau et Kevin Staut. Il y a quatre ans, au Danemark, le Suédois Henrik von Eckermann avait été sacré champion du monde. devant le Belge Jérôme Guéry et le Néerlandais Maikel Van der Vleuten.

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Suivez des courses du Championnat du monde de motocross. Chaque année, les meilleurs pilotes du monde s'affrontent pour le titre décerné par la Fédération internationale de motocyclisme. De mars à octobre, ils concourent sur 20 circuits en Europe, en Asie, en Amérique du Sud et du Nord. Le championnat du monde se déroule dans les catégories de moteurs MXGP, MX2 et MX3.

programme.title: Chamonix | Difficulté (H/F) - Finale
programme.desc: Chamonix accueille la 4e manche de la Coupe du monde de difficulté de la saison. Chez les dames, la Française Zélia Avezou tentera de briller devant son public. The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Fantasy Football Now: Season Preview
programme.desc: Fantasy Football Now (Sports). «Fantasy Football Now» airs live on Sunday mornings during the NFL season, a time when fans are making last-minute roster moves and need the latest news from around the league. Providing the latest info are host Field Yates, analyst Mike Clay, and senior writer and injury analyst Stephania Bell. Also contributing to the show are ESPN's NFL reporters, who bring fantasy players the latest intel from game sites and, in many cases, straight from the coach's mouth to give fantasy owners everything they need to know to set their lineups

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike & Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Fantasy Football Now: Season Preview
programme.desc: Fantasy Football Now (Sports). «Fantasy Football Now» airs live on Sunday mornings during the NFL season, a time when fans are making last-minute roster moves and need the latest news from around the league. Providing the latest info are host Field Yates, analyst Mike Clay, and senior writer and injury analyst Stephania Bell. Also contributing to the show are ESPN's NFL reporters, who bring fantasy players the latest intel from game sites and, in many cases, straight from the coach's mouth to give fantasy owners everything they need to know to set their lineups

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike & Mike» morning show

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Fantasy Football Now: Season Preview
programme.desc: Fantasy Football Now (Sports). «Fantasy Football Now» airs live on Sunday mornings during the NFL season, a time when fans are making last-minute roster moves and need the latest news from around the league. Providing the latest info are host Field Yates, analyst Mike Clay, and senior writer and injury analyst Stephania Bell. Also contributing to the show are ESPN's NFL reporters, who bring fantasy players the latest intel from game sites and, in many cases, straight from the coach's mouth to give fantasy owners everything they need to know to set their lineups

Providing the latest info are host Field Yates, analyst Mike Clay, and senior writer and injury analyst Stephania Bell. Also contributing to the show are ESPN's NFL reporters, who bring fantasy players the latest intel from game sites and, in many cases, straight from the coach's mouth to give fantasy owners everything they need to know to set their lineups

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: 30 for 30: Once Upon a Time in Queens, Part 1
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.

programme.title: GT World Challenge Australia: The Bend Motorsport Park
programme.desc: Coverage of the auto racing series for GT3 cars in Australia.

programme.title: GT World Challenge Europe
programme.desc: Pit stops, strategy and survival are the name of the game when the best GT racers in Europe battle it out in action packed endurance and sprint races at world-class circuits.

programme.title: Ferrari Challenge Europe
programme.desc: The Ferrari Challenge Europe is an one-make series for Ferraris with seven races across Europe.

programme.title: Porsche Carrera Cup Germany
programme.desc: The Porsche GT3 is the epitome of motorsport and the core of the Porsche Carrera Cup Germany.

programme.title: FIA European Truck Racing Championship Highlights
programme.desc: Race-prepared juggernauts from MAN, IVECO, Mercedes-Benz and Freightliner battle wheel-to-wheel across Europe.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Explore the engineering, design and history of a range of vehicles from across the globe.

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Exploring the luxury, speed, and high-tech power of the fastest and finest cars in the world; the workmanship, the highest level of engineering, and the most expensive price are the deciding factors for the winner of the Supercar Title.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: There are several kinds and sizes of pickups: based on passenger cars, light-duty utility vehicles or heavy-duty trucks with towing capacity up to 8.7 tons. Pickups are world-wide very successful.

programme.title: FastZone
programme.desc: A showcase of the action from the world of motorsport, from karting to F1 with a share of the fastest cars in the most thrilling races.

programme.title: Gearing Up
programme.desc: Exploring racing from the most demanding events around the globe.

programme.desc: From complexly rebuilt show cars to giant off-road monster trucks, anything is represented at the SEMA in Las Vegas; everybody from the tuning scene presents themselves during the cruise.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Heavy equipment comes into use as a car has to crash at full speed into a pile of gravel.

programme.title: Land Rover Experience Tour
programme.desc: Every other year, the Land Rover Experience Tour invites adventurers to explore the world's most remote areas. In 2017, it's time for next tour. The destination: Peru. 30,000 people applied, but only six of them qualified.

programme.title: Made in Germany
programme.desc: Eurocopter is the most successful and best-selling helicopter in the world.

programme.title: Car People

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Porsche cult attracts devoted fans who compare the driving experience of various models, from tractors to the Targa; for over five decades, enthusiasts remain loyal to these cars from Zuffenhausen.

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG S 63 E Performance features 802 horsepower and 1,430 Newton-meters of torque; this luxury sedan combines racing technology with serial production standards during a performance test in California.

programme.title: 4x4

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Fantasy Football Now: Season Preview
programme.desc: Fantasy Football Now (Sports). «Fantasy Football Now» airs live on Sunday mornings during the NFL season, a time when fans are making last-minute roster moves and need the latest news from around the league. Providing the latest info are host Field Yates, analyst Mike Clay, and senior writer and injury analyst Stephania Bell. Also contributing to the show are ESPN's NFL reporters, who bring fantasy players the latest intel from game sites and, in many cases, straight from the coach's mouth to give fantasy owners everything they need to know to set their lineups

Providing the latest info are host Field Yates, analyst Mike Clay, and senior writer and injury analyst Stephania Bell. Also contributing to the show are ESPN's NFL reporters, who bring fantasy players the latest intel from game sites and, in many cases, straight from the coach's mouth to give fantasy owners everything they need to know to set their lineups

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Fantasy Football Now: Season Preview
programme.desc: Fantasy Football Now (Sports). «Fantasy Football Now» airs live on Sunday mornings during the NFL season, a time when fans are making last-minute roster moves and need the latest news from around the league. Providing the latest info are host Field Yates, analyst Mike Clay, and senior writer and injury analyst Stephania Bell. Also contributing to the show are ESPN's NFL reporters, who bring fantasy players the latest intel from game sites and, in many cases, straight from the coach's mouth to give fantasy owners everything they need to know to set their lineups

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms
